capabilities: Sink completed tasks below unfinished siblings in the same contiguous list
Drag task checkboxes to reorder same-level sibling items
Drag ordered-list numbers to reorder numbered lists
Preserve list numbering such as lists starting at 5.
Select list items or paragraphs by clicking and dragging from the left margin
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only changes how existing Markdown checklists and numbered lists behave in the editor.
extras: The README states the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The left-margin selection feature comes from the standalone Margin Paragraph Select plugin, which should be disabled to avoid duplicate input handlers. Lists everything it does not support (Kanban cards, Tasks plugin queries, reading view, code blocks).
intentEvidence: Obsidian lists are excellent for thinking, but long checklists can become noisy as work changes.
motivation: The README says Obsidian lists are good for thinking but long checklists become noisy as work changes, so the author wanted to keep the editor calm.
problem: Long checklists in Obsidian get noisy as work changes, and there is no built-in way to sink done tasks or reorder list items by dragging.

relations.evidence: This integrates Margin Paragraph Select. Disable that standalone plugin when using Checklist Flow

summary: Editor plugin that sinks completed checklist tasks below unfinished siblings and lets you drag-reorder tasks and numbered list items.
